comment: Paul Yoon is the worst professor I have ever had at UR. He often doesn't undertand questions students ask and belittles them, and he is unavailable to students, as he only has 1 office hour. I had taken piano lessons as a kid so I was confident in my abilities but Yoon managed to make music theory more confusing and frustrating for me.

confusing and grades every homework assignment with great detail. not an intro level type class. Needs to chill on the transcribing music. Went into the class appreciating the music and left despising it.

took popular music in 70s and 80s. not a bad teacher but the assignments were pointless and didn't teach me anything. his grading is really tough. overall not a horrible class but don't think it's an easy gen ed

had him for pop music of 70s and 80s. not what i expected-thought hed be an older guy that actually lived through the time periods discussed (or atleast wasnt a baby during them). weird assignments that arent always well explained. glad to be done with him. not a bad guy and i learned some interesting stuff but overtall not great experience.

The pop music class is pretty easy and fun because it involves a lot of listening and discussion. Great way to fulfill the arts requirement. He's kind of an awkward guy, but he tries hard to connect with the students. Homework is not bad and he's a pretty easy grader. Participation is helpful because he favors the people who talk the most.

Yoon is a really cool music professor. I cannot say anything about his Core teaching but for Mus107 he was perfectly fine. It's not too hard if you can grasp the material, which is not horrid. He's a funny and easy-going guy. Recommended.
Visiting professor should go back to where ever hes visiting from
Absolutely awful professor. Hated him. Was rude to students and unwilling to help.
absolutely awful. avoid at all costs.

Horrible professor. Contradicts himself about what he's looking for in responses. Has one interpretation of the text and dismisses analysis that is contradictory to his won. He is an obvious reason of why core is no longer being taught, as an "ethnomusicology" professor cannot adequately teach material that should be taught by an english professor.

Yoon is great, took his pop music class.  If you do the reading, show up to class, and do the work, its an easy A to fulfill the FSVP requiement.  Hes such a nice and accomadating dude as well, taught us what we as a class were interested in learning about.  Strongly recommend any class he teaches for the FSVP

Yoon is a confusing teacher. He changes the syllabus a fair amount, and never likes to be challenged in class. If you disagree with him, he takes personal offense. Additionally, his teaching methods are very confusing, and he should try to act more like a professor than a friend to the students, bc it conflicts with trying to learn the material

Yoon is far and away the worst professor I have ever encountered. He changes the syllabus almost daily, what he expects for his assignments is extremely unclear, and he is overall an unlikable person. As a result of this unclearness most students perform poorly on assignments. He teaches a required BS class, and takes it entirly too seriously.
